data.coordinate_and_correspondence: All deformation gradients are dimensionless Cartesian column-vector maps x=F*X from the SAME undeformed reference basis and material correspondence. The supplied oriented F_B is fixed for the internal-interface test;do not independently rotate one constituent to rescue a rejected supplied orientation relationship. A single COMMON proper rotation of the whole laminate relative to the reference is permitted for the external-interface test.
data.mixture_model: A first-order fine laminate with volume fraction f of the supplied state B has macroscopic gradient (1-f)*F_A+f*F_B,with 0<f<1. Admissible internal layers require a nonzero rank-one jump F_B-F_A. At the macroscopic reference interface require existence of Q in SO(3),nonzero shear vector h and unit reference normal n such that Q*F_bar-I=h outer n. This is the ideal limiting macroscopic compatibility condition,not a claim that each microscopic twin meets the reference without a boundary layer.
data.numerical_reporting: Treat the printed controlled matrices as exact to their displayed precision. Use absolute singular-value tolerance 1e-9 for zero/rank and principal-stretch tolerance 1e-8 for unity. Return all physical fractions in ascending order;do not return the complementary fractions as two independent material phases.
data.scope: Controlled cubic-to-tetragonal-style deformation model,not measured lattice parameters,identified real phases,a prediction of equilibrium phase fractions or proof of low transformation hysteresis. No energetics,interface energy,finite twin spacing or nucleation kinetics are supplied.

provenance.kind: controlled computational analytical study, not experimental measurements
provenance.generation: Controlled computational input table for the stated study; not experimental measurements. Authentic source inputs are documented separately when present.
provenance.units: F,f,principal stretches and singular values dimensionless;common reference basis and orientation correspondence explicitly fixed.
